title: Deliver immutable newsletter exports and existing response routing contract
head: codex/shared-newsletter-browser-distribution-20261012
body:
Frontend PR16 requires an immutable distribution of the existing public @capiro/shared/newsletter and newsletter-render exports before its rich UI port. This delivers the unchanged private @capiro/shared@0.0.0 package archive, exact declarations/source bindings, browser consumer qualification and the intentional existing legacy Outreach response-routing contract.

Independent review verifies all entries,36 declarations,72 maps and all144 byte-identical pristine re-emitted outputs. Actual public CJS/ESM imports, strict NodeNext/browser declarations with six expected negative diagnostics, the five-module browser bundle/VM and116 original-C/packed/browser renderer characterizations pass. Two notifier-disabled packs reproduce identical bytes. The original offline pack's read-only npm metadata GET is retained and accurately corrected; no syscall network-containment claim is made. One initial successful independent esbuild timing log is unavailable, with its command/status/hash receipt and bundle retained; all final raw logs are intact.

The existing outbound_campaign metadata stage UUID/revision is a bounded response routing hint, subject to current canonical record/stage/actor/tenant/client authority. The current frontend parser strips metadata; frontend receiving-schema/dispatch implementation remains pending. Rich WsNewsletterStage IDs remain separate from saved WsDocVersion snapshot/hash/CAS/durable-receipt staging. No alternate DTO, renderer, wire version, store, request DTO or ID bridge is introduced.

There are zero application/package/compiler/source changes beyond draft PR2426. All39 Shared/compiler source files and727 inherited indexed files remain exact;960 composed hashes verify. Original producer/audit/review heads are actual preserved ancestors. No frontend edits, registry upload, provider/message/customer/DB/migration/native download, main merge or deployment.
